speaker: Matthew Cowley
title: Follow the Oracle of God
body: Through stories from history, we see that following the oracle of God, the prophet, is how we can receive guidance and protection from God.
body_paras: Through stories from history, we see that following the oracle of God, the prophet, is how we can receive guidance and protection from God.
_description: Discover how following God's living prophet brings victory and purpose, drawing on Brigham Young's legacy and ancient history to inspire graduates.
